title: Perturbations of a Schwarzschild black hole and Newman-Unti gauge
summary: In this paper, we derive the complete transformations of a generic first order perturbative metric in Schwarzschild spacetime to the Newman-Unti (NU) gauge in series expansion near null infinity. This allows us to determine the asymptotic shear, the mass aspect and the angular momentum aspect of the perturbative fields. As a direct application, we derive the corresponding asymptotic NU data for quasinormal modes (QNMs) of a Schwarzschild black hole.
